description: December 27 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a December 27 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the first decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: December 27 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: December 27 joins Saturn's realism, at five degrees of Capricorn, with 9, the number of compassion and completion. The blend is often read as mature kindness: a person who helps others in practical ways, offers sound advice and understands that every ending, even the end of a year, makes room for something more lasting.

On December 27 the Sun usually sits at about 5° Capricorn, in the first decan, where Saturn rules the decan as well as the sign. Saturn rules Capricorn and also governs the sign's first decan, which spans roughly December 22 to December 31. Birthdays here arrive at the turning point of the year, and this decan is traditionally read as the sign in its most concentrated form: patient, ambitious, realistic and willing to climb slowly. Responsibility often arrives early in life for these natives. Doubled Saturn can make them hard on themselves and reluctant to rest until the work is complete. Their quiet authority tends to grow with age, and humour, usually dry, is one of the ways they lighten what they carry.

sections.heading: December 27 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one December 27 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on December 27: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 27 is the 361st day of the year (362nd in a leap year). By January 21, 25 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aquarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on December 27 include Louis Pasteur (1822), Marlene Dietrich (1901) and Salman Khan (1965).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 27?
faq.answer: December 27 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 27 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 27?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a December 27 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 27?
faq.answer: December 27 is also the birthday of Louis Pasteur (1822), Marlene Dietrich (1901) and Salman Khan (1965). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
